scope: Open Legend roleplay and low-refusal LLM research

hardware_estimate_method: Idealized raw 4-bit weight bytes=parameters×0.5; excludes overhead and KV cache

baseline_references.name: DeepHermes 3 Mistral 24B Preview
baseline_references.reason: Collection update 2025-03-13; retain only as a hybrid-reasoning historical control. Hermes 4.3 is the newer documented Nous comparison.

baseline_references.name: Magnum v4 family
baseline_references.reason: Publisher profile lists 123B/72B and smaller releases updated 2024-11-25. Useful prose controls, but recent quant repacks do not make the underlying models current. Exact variant license must be checked.

baseline_references.name: Euryale L3.3 70B v2.3
baseline_references.reason: Publisher profile shows 2024-12-08 generation. Do not market it as a new 2026 Stheno successor merely because quants were uploaded later.

baseline_references.name: Midnight Miqu 70B v1.5
baseline_references.reason: Author collection updated 2024-12-10; old foundation and unclear commercial lineage make it a historical style reference, not a preferred new production dependency. Same author now has Glistening Gem 2.1.

baseline_references.name: RimDialogue 3B v1
baseline_references.reason: Historical game-NPC-specific Llama 3.2 example. Card says the associated mod was taken down by Ludeon; useful evidence of actual game-dialogue use, not a current integration recommendation.

baseline_references.name: Behemoth X 123B v2.2
baseline_references.reason: Card identifies Mistral Large 2411 lineage. A recent upload is not a contemporary foundation; newer Behemoth 128B v3 is tracked separately, with weak WIP evidence.

review_scope: All 34 records and tables reviewed; targeted primary-source spot checks, not a fresh full-market scan or model evaluation.
